Name: Decorative Beds for Custom Furniture (CF)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

Want to decorate a shed only to find that you can't place beds in them? Then this is the mod for you!

Purchase decorative beds from the Furniture Catalogue and put them anywhere. 

Okay, you won't be able to sleep in them but... that's not the point of a bed, right?

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/decorativebeds/img/1.png[/img]﻿

[b]Vanilla beds:[/b]
[list]
[*]Single Bed
[*]Double Bed
[*]Birch Double Bed
[*]Deluxe Red Double Bed
[*]Exotic Double Bed
[*]Fisher Double Bed
[*]Tropical Bed
[*]Tropical Double Bed
[*]Wild Double Bed
[*]Modern Double Bed
[*]Pirate Double Bed
[*]Starry Double Bed
[*]Strawberry Double Bed
[/list]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/decorativebeds/img/2.png[/img]

[b]Custom beds:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Fixed Pirate Double Bed[/size]
[*][size=3]Fixed Starry Double Bed[/size]
[*][size=3]Fixed Strawberry Double Bed[/size]
[*][size=3]Crib[/size]
[*][size=3]Playpen[/size]
[/list][size=3]﻿
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder
[/size][/list][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

You can find these beds in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b].

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).
